scanNote:
PHOTO FILE - UNIT 4 (raqamsiz bet, pdf 147). Qirqib olinadigan karta. Yuqorida to'q sariq 'UNIT 4'.

1-RASM: chang'ichi (sariq-ko'k kiyim, pushti shapka) qorli qiyalikda yiqilmoqda, chang'ilari uchib ketmoqda. YIRTIQ QOG'OZ (qaydlar): • Jack - experienced skier - alone on Swiss ski slope • suddenly - one of his skis hit something hard - Jack fly in air • try to stand up - break leg - not able to walk • sun start to set - Jack begin feel frightened. Ostida 5 ta bo'sh qator.

2-RASM: kasalxonada Jack karavotda, oyog'i gipsda osilgan; o'ylash pufagida katta Senbernar iti va Jack qorda. YIRTIQ QOG'OZ: • Jack in hospital - leg in plaster • lucky be alive • think about huge Saint Bernard dog - find him • Jack smile himself - "Thanks to the dog I didn't freeze to death." Ostida 5 ta bo'sh qator.

⚠ Bu 4-unitdagi Writing (hikoya yozish - past simple/past continuous) uchun shablon.

sections.title: Photo File - Unit 4: Jack's skiing accident (story)

exercises.instructionEn: Read the notes and look at the pictures. Picture 1: Jack - experienced skier - alone on Swiss ski slope; suddenly - one of his skis hit something hard - Jack fly in air; try to stand up - break leg - not able to walk; sun start to set - Jack begin feel frightened. Picture 2: Jack in hospital - leg in plaster; lucky be alive; think about huge Saint Bernard dog - find him; Jack smile himself - "Thanks to the dog I didn't freeze to death."
exercises.instructionUz: Qaydlarni o'qing va rasmlarga qarang. 1-rasm: Jack - tajribali chang'ichi - Shveytsariya qiyaligida yolg'iz; to'satdan - chang'ilaridan biri qattiq narsaga urildi - Jack havoga uchdi; turishga harakat - oyog'i sindi - yura olmadi; quyosh bota boshladi - Jack qo'rqa boshladi. 2-rasm: Jack kasalxonada - oyog'i gipsda; tirik qolganidan omadli; ulkan Senbernar itini o'ylaydi - uni topdi; Jack o'ziga jilmayadi - "It tufayli muzlab o'lmadim."
exercises.explanationUz:
HIKOYa QAYDLARI - ikki rasm, ikki
qaydlar to'plami.


1-RASM (hodisa):
  • Jack - tajribali chang'ichi -
    Shveytsariya chang'i qiyaligida
    yolg'iz
  • to'satdan - chang'ilaridan biri
    qattiq narsaga urildi - Jack
    havoga uchdi
  • turishga harakat qildi - oyog'i
    singan - yura olmadi
  • quyosh bota boshladi - Jack
    qo'rqa boshladi

2-RASM (yakun):
  • Jack kasalxonada - oyog'i gipsda
  • tirik qolganidan omadli
  • ulkan Senbernar itini o'ylaydi -
    u Jackni topgan
  • Jack o'ziga jilmayadi: "It
    tufayli muzlab o'lmadim."


⚠ QAYDLARDAN HIKOYaGA:

  Qaydlar - fe'lning ASOSIY shakli.
  Hikoyada O'TGAN ZAMONGA
  aylantiring:
  'fly' → flew; 'break' → broke;
  'start' → started; 'begin' →
  began; 'find' → found.


⚠ 'EXPERIENCED':

  = tajribali.


⚠ 'A SKI SLOPE':

  = chang'i qiyaligi.


⚠ 'IN PLASTER':

  = gipsda.


⚠ 'A SAINT BERNARD':

  = Senbernar (Alp tog'larida
  qutqaruvchi it zoti).


⚠ 'THANKS TO':

  = ... tufayli, sharofati bilan.


⚠ 'TO FREEZE TO DEATH':

  = muzlab o'lmoq.

exercises.instructionEn: Use the notes and the pictures to write the story of Jack's skiing accident (Unit 4, Writing). Use past tenses.
exercises.instructionUz: Qaydlar va rasmlardan foydalanib Jackning chang'i hodisasi hikoyasini yozing (4-unit, Yozuv). O'tgan zamonlarni ishlating.
exercises.explanationUz:
HIKOYa TUZILIShI:

  1-XATBOShI (1-rasm): kim, qayerda,
    nima bo'ldi - past simple + past
    continuous ('was skiing when
    ...')
  2-XATBOShI (2-rasm): yakun -
    kasalxona, it, his-tuyg'u

  ⚠ Bog'lovchilar: suddenly, when,
  then, luckily, in the end.
  ⚠ Past continuous - fon: 'Jack
  was skiing alone ...'
  ⚠ Past simple - voqealar: 'hit',
  'flew', 'broke'.

structure.modelEn: Jack was an experienced skier. One day, he was skiing alone on a Swiss ski slope when suddenly one of his skis hit something hard and Jack flew into the air. He tried to stand up, but he had broken his leg and he was not able to walk. The sun started to set and Jack began to feel frightened.
structure.modelUz: Jack tajribali chang'ichi edi. Bir kuni u Shveytsariya chang'i qiyaligida yolg'iz chang'i uchayotganda to'satdan chang'ilaridan biri qattiq narsaga urildi va Jack havoga uchdi. U turishga harakat qildi, lekin oyog'i singan edi va yura olmadi. Quyosh bota boshladi va Jack qo'rqa boshladi.
structure.noteUz: 'was skiing ... when ... hit' - past continuous + past simple.

structure.modelEn: The next day, Jack was in hospital with his leg in plaster. He was lucky to be alive. He thought about the huge Saint Bernard dog that had found him in the snow. Jack smiled to himself. "Thanks to that dog, I didn't freeze to death," he said.
structure.modelUz: Ertasi kuni Jack oyog'i gipsda kasalxonada edi. U tirik qolganidan omadli edi. U uni qorda topgan ulkan Senbernar itini o'yladi. Jack o'ziga jilmaydi. "O'sha it tufayli muzlab o'lmadim", - dedi u.

modelAnswers:
Jack was an experienced skier. One day, he was skiing alone on a Swiss ski slope when suddenly one of his skis hit something hard and Jack flew into the air. He tried to stand up, but he had broken his leg and he was not able to walk. The sun started to set and Jack began to feel frightened.

The next day, Jack was in hospital with his leg in plaster. He was lucky to be alive. He thought about the huge Saint Bernard dog that had found him in the snow. Jack smiled to himself. "Thanks to that dog, I didn't freeze to death," he said.
modelAnswersUz:
Jack tajribali chang'ichi edi. Bir kuni u Shveytsariya chang'i qiyaligida yolg'iz chang'i uchayotganda to'satdan chang'ilaridan biri qattiq narsaga urildi va Jack havoga uchdi. U turishga harakat qildi, lekin oyog'i singan edi va yura olmadi. Quyosh bota boshladi va Jack qo'rqa boshladi.

Ertasi kuni Jack oyog'i gipsda kasalxonada edi. U tirik qolganidan omadli edi. U uni qorda topgan ulkan Senbernar itini o'yladi. Jack o'ziga jilmaydi. "O'sha it tufayli muzlab o'lmadim", - dedi u.

patterns.formula: X was + -ING when suddenly + PAST SIMPLE.
patterns.exampleEn: He was skiing alone when suddenly one of his skis hit something hard.
patterns.exampleUz: U yolg'iz chang'i uchayotganda to'satdan chang'ilaridan biri qattiq narsaga urildi.

patterns.formula: X tried to + FE'L, but + GAP.
patterns.exampleEn: He tried to stand up, but he had broken his leg.
patterns.exampleUz: U turishga harakat qildi, lekin oyog'i singan edi.

patterns.formula: Thanks to X, I didn't + FE'L.
patterns.exampleEn: Thanks to that dog, I didn't freeze to death.
